paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: The plot compares the Micro-F1 scores (%) of two systems—MatDetector (ours) and ChemDataExtractor—across a range of λ values. The x-axis represents the λ value, ranging from "w/o" (without) to 3, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.1 from 0.1 to 1.0, followed by 2 and 3. The scale is linear, and the labels are evenly spaced. The y-axis shows the Micro-F1 Score (%) ranging from 52 to 58, with major gridlines and tick marks at 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, and 58, also on a linear scale. The MatDetector (ours) is represented by a solid magenta line with circular markers, while ChemDataExtractor is shown as a dashed dark blue line with square markers. For MatDetector, the score starts at approximately 53% at λ = 0.1, dips to around 52.5% at λ = 0.2, rises to 54% at λ = 0.3, fluctuates slightly, then increases sharply to a peak of 58% at λ = 1.0, before dropping to about 53.2% at λ = 3. ChemDataExtractor begins at approximately 53% at λ = 0.1, dips to around 52.3% at λ = 0.3, rises to about 54.5% at λ = 0.8, peaks at 55% at λ = 0.9, and then stabilizes around 54% for λ = 1.0 to 3. The two lines cross multiple times, with MatDetector generally achieving higher scores, especially at λ = 1.0.
